title: Figure 1: Illustration of the Casimir effect; Figure 2: Vacuum-fluctuation battery
description: Figure 1 shows two parallel "Casimir plates" with green wavy lines labeled "Vacuum fluctuations" and large blue arrows pushing the plates together. Figure 2 is a line drawing of a stack of charged annular plates marked with + signs, labeled "Electrostatic Repulsion" and "Vacuum Fluctuation Attraction". Captions: "Figure 1. Illustration of the Casimir Effect" and "Figure 2. Vacuum-Fluctuation Battery (Reference 9)". Appears in section "II. Historical Concepts for Extracting Energy and Thermodynamic Considerations."
